```
tests/e2e/seq_store/test_recovery.py:48: AssertionError
```

```
git bisect start HEAD origin/main~10
# run CI job locally via ./scripts/run_integration.sh --filter test_recovery
```

ci-bot: Re-run queued by maria. Job 98765 -> 98766

eng-infra-oncall: Bisect narrowed it down to commit 3f4a2b7 (PR 8419) — which touches snapshot timer helper. Not Olga's merge. Reproduces locally with seed 42.
olga: Thanks for checking. That PR touched the helper indirectly; I'll pull a fix branch and run tests.
maria: For now I'm going to pin main to last green and open a hotfix branch. @sam can you assist with patch review?
sam: On it. Also adding test retry wrapper for that flaky assertion as temporary guard. :thumbsup:
maria: Great. Let's keep updates here. I'll post PR numbers when ready.
